in_marathi.long_meaning: Chitrita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chitrita is a Sanskrit name which means 'Picture or Image'. It is derived from the word 'chitra' which refers to a picture or image.
